title: A Place to Work
description: Every good slime needs a workbench. Build one and set it up in the clearing.

stages.title: Build a workbench
stages.description: Pick up the wood lying around the clearing, then open your bag and craft a Workbench in the Crafting tab.

stages.title: Set it up
stages.description: Open your bag, choose the Workbench, and place it somewhere handy.

offer: Ah, a new slime in the clearing! Welcome, little one.
The forest beyond is no place for bare goo. Before anything else, you need a place to make things.
Gather the wood lying around here and build yourself a workbench. Then set it up somewhere you like.
progress: A workbench is the heart of every camp. Wood is scattered all over the clearing.
complete: A fine bench! You have a knack for this.
Here, take this bundle of wood, and let me show you how to shape stone into tools.

title: Slime Basics
description: A first look at everything a slime can use: the bag and its tabs, the map, sprinting and the pause menu.

stages.title: Learn the basics
stages.description: Open each menu once and try a sprint.

objectives.label: Pause to save or change settings

title: Stone Tools
description: Craft a stone axe and pickaxe at your workbench, then put them to work on trees and rocks.

stages.title: Make your tools
stages.description: Use your Workbench to craft both stone tools.

stages.title: Put them to work
stages.description: Hold the axe to chop trees and the pickaxe to break rocks: switch between them on your belt.

offer: With a bench you can make proper tools. An axe for the trees, a pickaxe for the rocks.
Craft both, then show me you can use them.
progress: Trees need an axe, rocks need a pickaxe, and only the one in your hand works. No amount of bouncing will do it, trust me.
complete: Now you are a real gatherer!
One more lesson before you go: a slime that stands still gets squashed. When something swings at you, tuck in and roll away!
Worms have been creeping close to the clearing. It is time you learned to make a spear.

title: Worm Trouble
description: Mossy spotted a worm camp near the clearing. Arm yourself with a spear and drive them out.

stages.title: Arm yourself
stages.description: Craft a Wooden Spear at your workbench and equip it from your bag.

stages.title: Clear the worm camp
stages.description: The worms gather south-east of the clearing.

offer: Psst! Over here. Keep your voice down.
There is a worm camp just past the clearing. They keep coming back, and they are getting bolder.
You will want a spear for this. Make one, then thin their numbers.
progress: Keep your distance and let the spear do the work. Worms hate reach.
complete: You fought well, but you move like a puddle. Watch me: squish down, then spring! That is how a slime jumps. Go on, try it!
I have seen something much bigger in the east. A one-eyed blob guarding a chest. Wood will not be enough for that. Here is how to make a stone spear.

title: The One-Eyed Guardian
description: Fatty One Eye guards the key to the Verdant Gate. Forge a stone spear, defeat him, and step into Gloop Forest.

stages.title: A sharper point
stages.description: Craft a Stone Spear at your workbench.

stages.title: Face the guardian
stages.description: Only a spear can reach his eye. Watch for his leap and strike when he lands.

stages.title: Through the Verdant Gate
stages.description: Take the green key from his chest and open the eastern gate.

offer: So Mossy told you about the guardian. Fatty One Eye.
He has sat on the key to the Verdant Gate for as long as I can remember. Beyond it lies Gloop Forest, and the rest of the world.
Make a stone spear. Aim for the eye. And come back in one piece.
progress: Aim for the eye, and never stand where his shadow lands.

title: The Old Workshop
description: The Workshop in the woodcutter yard fell to ruin when the worms came. Bring wood and stone and rebuild it.

stages.title: Rebuild the Workshop
stages.description: Gather 60 wood and 40 stone, then restore the ruined Workshop north of the plaza.

offer: See that wreck by the woodpile? That was our Workshop, before the worms chased everyone off.
A workbench is fine for tools, but the Workshop can make real gear. Heavier things. Better things.
Bring sixty wood and forty stone and fix it up. It is yours to use once it stands again.
progress: Sixty wood, forty stone. Trees and rocks grow back if you give them time.

title: A Tonic for Lili
description: Lili wants to learn how berries become a healing tonic. Brew one to show her.

stages.title: Brew a tonic
stages.description: Find purple berries in the clearing and brew a Slime Tonic in the Crafting tab.

objectives.label: Brew a Slime Tonic (3 purple berries)

offer: Hi again! Everyone says purple berries can be brewed into a tonic that heals you.
Could you make one and show me? I would love to see how it works!
progress: Purple berries grow in little clumps around the clearing. You need three!
complete: Here, take the berries left over from my basket. Maybe someone else could use them.

title: Snack for the Road
description: Lily has been fishing all day without a bite, or a bite to eat. Pack her a berry basket.

stages.title: Pack a snack
stages.description: Weave a small basket of berries in the Crafting tab.

offer: Shh... you will scare the fish. Not that there are any.
I have been out here since sunrise and forgot to pack lunch. Could you put together a little berry basket for me?
progress: A couple of berries and a bit of wood for the basket. That is all I need.
complete: Mmm, just what I needed. Food makes the waiting easier.
Take this tonic. My grandmother brewed it. I never get hurt out here anyway.
